session.description: GLM agent session with full reliability stack: rules, hooks, external task-state, subagents, verification gates.

events.Stop: scripts/stop-verify.sh (block stop until tasks done + tests pass)

task_state.purpose: External task memory — GLM never relies on context window for progress

profiles.planner: Decompose task into TASKSTATE subtasks, demand evidence
profiles.glm-baseline: GLM executor without infra (control group for A/B)
profiles.auditor: Read-only verifier — independently checks claimed results

verification.gate: stop blocked unless exit 0 and all subtasks verified

kickoff_prompt: You are the GLM agent in an upgraded Devin session. Read AGENTS.md first — it is mandatory. Initialize task state with scripts/taskstate.sh init using the task in demo/TASK.md. Follow Explore -> Plan -> Implement -> Verify. Before finishing, run scripts/verify.sh and report real output. You may not stop while state/TASKSTATE.json has incomplete subtasks or verification is failing. Begin now.
kickoff_prompt_experiment: Run the GLM A/B experiment per EXPERIMENT.md: (1) RUN A — spawn foreground subagent profile 'glm-baseline' with task 'Complete demo/TASK.md in demo/, report real command output'. (2) Restore demo/budget.py from demo/budget.buggy.py. (3) RUN B — spawn profile 'glm-worker' with same task, then profile 'auditor' to independently verify. Report which EXPERIMENT.md rubric items each run passed/failed.
